description.value: Numero Uno Pizza is a family-run thin-crust gourmet pizza shop on Davie Street in downtown Vancouver, baking with house-made dough and sauce and offering a broad menu of meaty and vegetarian pies available by the slice or whole. The shop supports dine-in, takeout, delivery, and catering, making it a flexible stop for solo riders or larger cycling groups. Its location in the heart of the West End puts it within easy reach of the Seawall route.
